description:
Cookie-cut from jmap-mail-client (canonical extension-client template per workspace AGENTS.md).

Scaffolding:
- Cargo.toml (deps: jmap-types, jmap-metadata-types, jmap-base-client, tokio, thiserror)
- src/lib.rs with JmapMetadataExt trait
- src/methods/{metadata_get,metadata_changes,metadata_set,metadata_query,metadata_query_changes}.rs
- AGENTS.md, PLAN.md, README.md

Client methods mirror the extension-client family pattern:
- pub async fn metadata_get(...) -> Result<GetResponse<Metadata>, ClientError>
- pub async fn metadata_set(...) -> Result<SetResponse<Metadata>, ClientError>
- etc.

wiremock-backed tests for each method asserting on wire-body shape per the draft.

Blocked-on: JMAP-06zp.1.
title: Create new jmap-metadata-client crate (client method bindings)
